faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

q1.question: How do I pair my Taykie device?
q1.answer: Make sure your Taykie is charged and nearby, turn on Bluetooth, then open the Device tab and tap Start searching. Press the button on top of the device to activate pairing.

q2.question: Will my reminders work if my phone is off or out of range?
q2.answer: Yes, for schedules you sync to the device. Go to Device > On-Device Reminders and choose the times you want. The device rings from its own clock. Monthly schedules only work as phone reminders.

q3.question: How many reminders can my device hold?
q3.answer: The device holds up to 10 reminder slots in total. If you reach the limit, remove another time first to make room.

q4.question: What do the LED colors on my Taykie mean?
q4.answer: White means connected, red means low battery, green means fully charged, blue means a medication reminder is active, and warm yellow means charging. Tap the information icon on the Device tab to see this list.

q5.question: I opened my Taykie but the app didn't register a dose. What now?
q5.answer: Go to Device > Unconfirmed opens and tell us what you did each time the device was opened, such as taking a dose or refilling the box.

q6.question: What is the device password?
q6.answer: It is a 6-digit Bluetooth pairing PIN, separate from your account password. The factory default is 000000. You can change it from Device > Change Device Password.

q7.question: How do I change how many times a day Taykie reminds me?
q7.answer: Open Settings > Dosage & Compartments and pick once, twice or three times a day, then save your changes.

q8.question: How do I export or delete my data?
q8.answer: Open Settings > Data & Privacy to export your data or delete your account. A deleted account can be restored within 30 days, after which it is permanently removed.

q9.question: How do I change the app language?
q9.answer: Open Settings > Account and choose your language.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro:
Effective Date: April 17, 2026
Last Updated: April 17, 2026

s1.heading: Introduction
s1.body:
Welcome to Taykie ("we," "our," or "us"). Taykie is a wellness supplement tracking platform that helps you manage your medication schedules, connect with a health community, and sync with your Taykie Smart Pill Box device.
This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and the choices you have. By using Taykie, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

s2.heading: Information We Collect
s2.body:
Information you provide directly:

Account details: name, email address, password, username, profile photo
Onboarding data: country, language, dose frequency, supplement names and dosages, refill preferences, reminder settings
Health and medication data: supplement names, dosages, schedules, dose history, adherence records, dose notes and logs
Community content: posts, comments, poll votes, group memberships, likes, bookmarks
Communications: support requests, feedback, reports submitted about other users

Information collected automatically:

Device information: device type, operating system, app version
Usage data: features used, screens visited, session duration, error logs
Push notification tokens (FCM) for delivering reminders
BLE device data: Smart Pill Box connection status, compartment state, sync sessions, medication history uploaded from the device

Information from third parties:

If you sign in with Google or Apple, we receive your name, email address, and a unique identifier from that provider. We do not receive your password from these providers.

s3.heading: How We Use Your Information
s3.body:
We use your information to:

Create and manage your account
Deliver dose reminders, snooze notifications, refill alerts, and missed dose alerts
Sync data with your Taykie Smart Pill Box via Bluetooth
Display your schedule history, streaks, adherence insights, and monthly calendar
Power community features including posts, groups, comments, and suggested connections
Recommend groups and users based on your activity and social connections
Generate your data export when requested
Respond to support requests and investigate reported content
Improve our product through anonymized analytics
Comply with legal obligations

s4.heading: Health Data
s4.body:
Taykie collects and stores health-related information including supplement names, dosages, schedules, and adherence history. This data is:

Used only to provide the service to you
Never sold to advertisers or third-party data brokers
Never used to make automated decisions about your medical care
Stored securely and accessible only to you and authorized Taykie staff

Taykie is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. Always consult a healthcare professional regarding your medications and supplements.

s5.heading: Sharing Your Information
s5.body:
We do not sell your personal information. We may share it in the following circumstances:
With service providers: We use trusted third-party providers (cloud hosting, push notification services, analytics) who process data on our behalf under strict data processing agreements.
With other users: Your public profile, posts, group memberships, and community activity are visible to other Taykie users as part of the social features. You control what you post.
For legal reasons: We may disclose information if required by law, court order, or to protect the rights and safety of Taykie, our users, or the public.
Business transfers: If Taykie is acquired or merges with another company, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will notify you before this occurs.

s6.heading: Data Retention
s6.body:
We retain your data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account:

Your account is soft-deleted and enters a 30-day grace window during which you can restore it
After 30 days your account and associated data are permanently deleted
Some data may be retained in anonymized form for analytics purposes
Data required for legal compliance may be retained for longer periods

s7.heading: Your Rights
s7.body:
Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

Access the personal data we hold about you (use the Export Data feature in Settings)
Correct inaccurate data (via Profile Settings)
Delete your account and data (via Account Settings)
Withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent
Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@taykie.com.

s8.heading: Push Notifications
s8.body: We send push notifications for dose reminders, missed doses, snooze expiry, and community activity. You can manage notification preferences in the app under Settings → Notifications, or through your device's notification settings.

s9.heading: BLE Device Data
s9.body: When you pair a Taykie Smart Pill Box, the app communicates with the device over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). Data synced from your device (compartment status, dose history) is stored securely in your account and subject to this policy. You can unpair your device at any time in Settings → Device.

s10.heading: Children's Privacy
s10.body: Taykie is not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will delete it promptly.

s11.heading: Security
s11.body: We implement industry-standard security measures including encrypted data transmission (TLS), hashed passwords, access controls, and regular security reviews. No system is completely secure — if you believe your account has been compromised, contact us immediately at security@taykie.com.

s12.heading: Changes to This Policy
s12.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by sending a push notification or email before the changes take effect. Continued use of Taykie after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
